_meta.notes: Complete static mapping of Entorno Nauta Portal (cu.etecsa.enp_oficial) from JADX 1.5.6 and Apktool 3.0.3

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.About.role: Displays application version and ETECSA credits

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.InfoUser.role: Displays user profile and Nauta account status

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.MainActivity.role: Primary dashboard checking connectivitycheck.android.com/generate_204 and verifying AP MAC against enpserver.nauta.cu

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.NautaInfoActivity.role: Active session monitor polling EtecsaQueryServlet and triggering LogoutServlet

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.SendAccountService.role: Background service reporting AP/user telemetry to api-enp/userfakeap/ and api-enp/useretecsaap/

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.Settings.role: User preferences screen backed by enp.db settings table

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.SplashScreenActivi.role: Launcher splash activity initializing database and routing to MainActivity

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.UserAccountService.role: Floating overlay WindowManager service showing live session timer

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.a.role: Progress dialog displaying 'Verificando' during AP MAC verification

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.api.WifiAPService.role: Retrofit interface for api-enp/checkmac/, api-enp/userfakeap/, and api-enp/useretecsaap/

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.b.role: Progress dialog displaying 'Autenticando' during captive portal login

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.c.role: Progress dialog displaying 'Cargando' during portal page loads

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.d.role: Progress dialog displaying 'Conectando' during Wi-Fi/portal connection

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.e.a.a.role: Click listener interface for RecyclerView items

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.e.a.b.role: RecyclerView adapter rendering main dashboard menu icons

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.e.a.c.role: RecyclerView ViewHolder for dashboard menu tiles

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.f.b.role: Autocomplete suggestion entry holding username prefix and Nauta domain

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.g.a.role: Loads pinned X.509 certificate R.raw.server into a TLS SSLContext

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.g.c.role: JSoup and substring parser for secure.etecsa.net:8443 login, ATTRIBUTE_UUID, and remaining time

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.g.d.role: Applies bundled assets/fonts/*.ttf Typeface onto TextView instances

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.model.LoginPortalN.role: Captive portal login state model (URL and status message)

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.model.MenuIconItem.role: Dashboard menu item model (title and drawable resource)

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.model.ServicePostA.role: Retrofit request/response DTO for AP MAC verification

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.model.ServicePostU.role: Retrofit DTO for AP telemetry submission

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.model.Session.role: Active session state model persisted in enp.db

cu.etecsa.enp_oficial.model.SettingsItem.role: Settings toggle model (title, subtitle, checked state)
